_about: Curated public custom emoji sets that can serve as a bot's icon family. METADATA ONLY: no images, no custom_emoji_id values. Ids are resolved on demand with getStickerSet(name) (scripts/emoji_packs.py resolve). Existence of every set below was checked on 2026-11-15 by opening https://t.me/addemoji/<name> (the page names an 'emoji set' with the title recorded here; an unknown name shows a generic 'sticker set' page). Style, animation and adaptive colour are NOT knowable from that page: `animation` and `adaptive` stay null until a resolve reads Sticker.is_animated / is_video / needs_repainting. Style words come from the set title only - look at the set in a chat before committing.
licensing: Custom emoji sets are created by their authors and published through Telegram. Using a set's emoji in your bot's messages and buttons by id is the use Telegram designed; the artwork stays on Telegram's servers and the author keeps the rights. This skill never bundles, downloads or redistributes sticker files. Credit the author when a set defines your bot's look, and ask the author before using a set as part of a commercial brand identity. Brand logos (crypto, companies) belong to their trademark owners. Not legal advice.

packs.name: tgmacicons
packs.title: TG iOS & macOS Icons
packs.style: interface glyphs in the manner of Telegram's iOS/macOS apps (by title)
packs.animation: static (4 of 4 sampled stickers; full set not resolved offline)
packs.choose_when: You want icons that look like part of the Telegram client itself; utility and product bots.
packs.avoid_when: The brand needs its own drawing style.
packs.evidence: t.me page title; four ids in examples/python/icons/fixtures/tgmacicons.partial.json were supplied by a bot owner

packs.name: tgiosicons
packs.title: Telegram iOS Icons
packs.style: interface glyphs in the manner of Telegram's iOS app (by title)
packs.choose_when: Gap filler for tgmacicons, or the primary set when it covers more of your slots.
packs.avoid_when: Mixed with Android- or Unigram-style sets on one bot.

packs.name: TgAndroidIcons
packs.title: Telegram Android Icons
packs.style: interface glyphs in the manner of Telegram's Android app (by title)
packs.choose_when: Your audience is mostly on Android or you prefer Material-like glyphs.

packs.name: UnigramIcons
packs.title: Unigram - @SOUICdsgn
packs.author: @SOUICdsgn
packs.style: interface glyphs in the manner of the Unigram desktop client (by title)
packs.choose_when: A desktop-feeling, Fluent-like look; pairs with the same author's status set.

packs.name: EmojiStatus
packs.title: Status - @SOUICdsgn
packs.author: @SOUICdsgn
packs.style: status marks by the author of UnigramIcons (by title)
packs.choose_when: Status slots (done, pending, failed, warning) next to UnigramIcons.
packs.avoid_when: Your action icons come from another family.
packs.evidence: t.me page title (the name emojistatus opens the same set)

packs.name: DMJUnigramAnimationEmoji
packs.title: Unigram Animations Emoji (@DMJ_Stickers)
packs.author: @DMJ_Stickers
packs.animation: animated (title; one sampled id recorded as animated in examples/case-studies/btc-tracker/icon-map.json)
packs.choose_when: One hero moment (success screen, an AI 'working' line), never a whole keyboard.
packs.avoid_when: Buttons and dense lists - animation competes with labels.

packs.name: UI_icons
packs.title: UI Animation @technoprint_official
packs.author: @technoprint_official
packs.choose_when: A lively bot whose owner accepts animated icons in titles and posts.
packs.avoid_when: Utility bots; anything with long keyboards.

packs.name: AIActions
packs.title: AI Actions
packs.choose_when: Official recommendation: the Bot API's InputRichBlockThinking points to this set for <tg-thinking> blocks. Use it for the thinking line only.
packs.avoid_when: As the bot's general icon family.
packs.evidence: Bot API docs (InputRichBlockThinking) link; t.me page title

packs.name: cryptoicons
packs.title: Crypto Logos @Capico_Bot
packs.author: @Capico_Bot
packs.choose_when: Inline coin marks next to tickers (BTC, ETH, TON) in wallet/price bots - content marks, not UI icons.
packs.avoid_when: Buttons; any slot that is not a coin. Logos are trademarks of their projects.
packs.evidence: t.me page title (the name CryptoIcons opens the same set)

packs.name: NewsEmoji
packs.title: News Emoji
packs.choose_when: Channel posts: headline and section accents for a news/digest channel (needs the Fragment route for channels).

packs.name: StatusEmoji
packs.title: Status Emoji
packs.choose_when: Only if its marks match your action family after looking at both in a chat.
packs.avoid_when: As a gap filler for a different family.
